model_output.summary: Closing $1.1M in new annual recurring revenue in 2025 gives your account executive work a concrete result worth keeping near the top. You also built a payroll-partner referral program, but the resume leaves room to explain how you developed those relationships. That detail could help a reviewer understand how you create opportunities beyond your own pipeline.
